name: use-scroll-overflow
title: Use Scroll Overflow
author: @fma-ds/ds
description: useScrollOverflow: the horizontal overflow of a scroller — whether content is hidden before or after the visible area (following the writing direction), a page turn toward a side aligned to the items, and revealing one element without scrolling the page. Edges kept clear (arrows, fades) come from the scroller's `scroll-padding`. Used by tab-nav and tabs for their scroll arrows.
